reviews.title: Beautiful, durable, and great airflow
reviews.comment: Beautiful case that has great airflow and opportunity for lots of fans! This case looks clean with and without RGB, it’s made of durable metal and excellent quality. The noise level is minimal with arctic fans, and has plenty of room for large GPU’s
reviews.author: Austin

reviews.title: Easy to work with, quiet, great airflow and highly customizable
reviews.comment:
A wonderful and easy to use modular case.
Stylish and easy to clean and plenty of room to tweak and make changes as you upgrade your build.
Want to go from 120 to 140mm fans you can even up to 160mm fans.
You can even swap in the included side panel for 3 additional side fans for more airflow.
Truly a pc gamers dream for making their own build. <3
Super quiet and sleak just a perfect case thank you Corsair 😊
reviews.author: Ryan.D

reviews.title: Great product, great price, great looks
reviews.comment:
Great quality and easy to work with. Looks amazing. Very happy with this (Frame 4000D - white) case.
Only downside so far is my new GPU (Sapphire 9070XT) isn't in the right spot for the adjustable support peg. It misses in the normal slot, and hits the fan when using the extra part that it comes with to put said peg closer to the mobo.
reviews.author: Andrew Sprague

reviews.title: Solid First-Timer Case
reviews.comment: Roomy and easy to build in. The front, sides and top panels can all be removed, and the front panel includes a magnetic mesh panel that can be quickly detached and cleaned. My only complaint is that the InfiniRail system was confusing as a first time PC builder. It's a handy feature for enthusiasts with fans/radiators of different sizes, but for a first build it largely over-complicates fan/radiator installation. Other than that, the case offers a largely pleasant building experience.
reviews.author: Steph

reviews.title: Great case!
reviews.comment: I am very happy with this case. Very airy, love the dust screens, and the glass side is really nice. Plenty of room to work around inside and do cable management as well.
